title: Check If a Number Is Majority Element in a Sorted Array
summary: Determine if an integer in a sorted array appears more than half the array's length.
statement: Determine if an integer in a sorted array appears more than half the array's length.
constraints: A majority occurs strictly more than n/2 times.
hints: Sorted duplicates occupy one contiguous interval.
Binary search for the first and first-after-target positions.
Their difference is the frequency; compare it strictly with n//2.
The two boundaries count exactly every target occurrence in logarithmic time.
editorial: The two boundaries count exactly every target occurrence in logarithmic time.

tests.explanation: Five occupies five of nine positions, so it is a majority.
Two of four is not strictly more than half.
